name: Easy UI
summary: Open-source gallery of free and premium website templates and blocks built with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
description: Website templates and page blocks built with React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Aceternity UI and Framer Motion. Free templates are browsable by category (landing page, e-commerce, marketing, AI, portfolio, docs) and difficulty; a paid Premium tier adds 100+ blocks and templates.
contains: free templates plus paid premium blocks
categories: landing page, e-commerce, marketing, AI, portfolio, docs
template sections: hero, bento, features, tech stack, changelog, FAQ, footer, mobile responsive navbar
built with React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Aceternity UI and Framer Motion
